pattern: SELECT .+ FROM ([a-zA-Z0-9]+)_names JOIN cars_data ON ([a-zA-Z0-9]+)\._Id = cars_data\.Id WHERE cars_data\.(.*) < ( SELECT AVG\(cars_data\.Weight\) FROM cars_data )
correction: SELECT T1.\<column\_name\> FROM CAR\_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS\_DATA AS T2 ON T1.\<MakeId\> = T2.\<Id\> WHERE T2.\<Weight\> < (SELECT avg(T2.Weight) FROM CARS\_DATA)

metadata.description: This rule corrects errors in SQL queries where the incorrect table aliases are used during a join operation, and the wrong column is selected for aggregation.
